rationale: Exact task/assignment mechanics recur, while annotation, quality, stewardship and approval products retain work content and outcome authority.
A review issue is an evidence-anchored challenge lifecycle; analytical cases and quality incidents have broader product-specific meaning and remain neighbors.
Statistical similarity, rule definition, rule evaluation and authority-scoped judgment differ in algebra, evidence, authority and failure modes.
Paxos/Raft-style agreement concerns replicated machine state under failures; reviewer consensus combines attributed judgments and preserves dissent under domain rules.
